title: Name a value
summary: R: Name a value. Start with 6 pencils. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: The <- arrow assigns a value to a name. Here pencils keeps the number 3.

blocks.text: Install R. Save an example as lesson.R and run Rscript lesson.R, or paste it into the R console.
The left arrow stores 3. cat receives the sum of that value and 2.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use a number without quotes for maths.
